rdfs:label: replaces
rdfs:comment: A related resource that the described resource supplants, displaces, or supersedes.
notes: Use to record that this resource is the new official version of an older one (a v2 spec replacing v1, a new policy replacing the prior one). The inverse is `urn:solid:isReplacedBy`. For term-level supersession inside the urn-solid registry itself, the term-file `supersededBy` field (mapped to dcterms:isReplacedBy in context.jsonld) is the right place.

history.note: seeAlso now urn:solid:isReplacedBy/isVersionOf (removed non-term supersededBy); added notToBeConfusedWith; notes use urn term.
